pages.title: Oven Dispatch
pages.text: A Gingerbread helper connects item transport to a chosen barrel.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Power the oven and set frosting with a Rock Candy block below it. Helpers fight different frosting, gather drops and deposit into barrels; collected candy also builds their armor.

pages.title: Practical note
pages.text: Create a Gingerbread helper and receive an item it deposits into a Gingerbarrel. Power the oven and set frosting with a Rock Candy block below it. Helpers fight different frosting, gather drops and deposit into barrels; collected candy also builds their armor.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Bind a Biome Treat and finish local Crucible conversion. Craft the sack from Sweet Tooth and drag food onto it; it feeds a hungry carrier. Eat a Biome Treat while fully starving in the desired biome, toss it into the crucible and fulfill all requests including its final rare item.
